translations.web: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
translations.bsb: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
translations.kjv: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
translations.asv: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
